title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Blackcurrant Aniseed 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant Aniseed from the JNP Bar Salts collection delivers a bold, complex, and intensely characterful profile. The rich, dark tang of ripe Blackcurrant provides a deep berry foundation, which is expertly contrasted by the sharp, slightly spicy bite of botanical Aniseed. This pairing offers a highly layered and memorable vape that balances deep sweetness with a clean, brisk finish. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the bold layers of Blackcurrant Aniseed, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the classic Double Apple Shisha or the exotic Summer Dream.
